purpose: Earned paperwork receipts for costly, successful actions; the original risks and failures remain unchanged.

payoffs.message: Gus slides a signed duplicate work order through the vent. You keep the spare Form; Facilities now has to acknowledge the original.
Beverly gives you a stamped copy of violation thirty-two. This Form proves you opened the real inspection route.
The kitchen wraps its tomato in a blank, stamped requisition Form. Someone there still believes paperwork can feed people.
A voucher marked KEVIN slips through the drain. Facilities reluctantly counts it as one Form.
